summary: Build practical oil and gas safety standards and practices skills in 5 days. Apply ISO 45001, risk assessment, and control of work tools.
lede: Oil and gas safety courses help HSE professionals, supervisors, engineers, and maintenance leaders control workplace and process hazards. Participants practise risk assessment, HAZOP and bow-tie analysis, critical-barrier checks, permit-to-work and isolation controls, and incident learning. They also explore emergency readiness, contractor assurance, and digital inspection workflows to support safer decisions across operational activities.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who make or influence safety decisions across upstream, midstream, downstream, and supporting oil and gas operations. It is appropriate for intermediate practitioners who have operational exposure and need a structured approach to applying safety standards, critical controls, and process safety methods.
prerequisites: You should have at least one year of exposure to oil and gas operations, maintenance, drilling, engineering, contracting, or HSE activities. Prior knowledge of workplace hazard identification is useful, but formal certification is not required. No coding or programming is required. You should bring examples of common work activities, incident trends, or safety challenges from your operating context if permitted by your organization. Advanced process safety methods such as HAZOP, LOPA, and bow-tie analysis are taught at an operational application level, while specialized quantitative risk analysis remains conceptual.
